_comment: Registry of real (non-synthetic) document sources. scripts/fetch_sources.py downloads ONLY entries with terms.status == 'approved', and renders the table in docs/data.md from this file. 'candidate_url' values come from web search results and have not been opened or verified. Set download_url only after checking the page. Entries with the same group_id (e.g. uz and ru versions of one act) always share a train/test split.
